title: Computable $K$-theory for C*-algebras II: AF algebras
summary: We continue the study of the effective content of $K$-theory for C*-algebras, with a focus on AF algebras. We show that from a c.e. presentation of an AF algebra it is possible to compute a representation of the algebra as an inductive limit of finite-dimensional algebras. Using this, and an analogous result for dimension groups, we show that the computable $K_0$ functor provides a computable equivalence of categories between c.e. presentations of AF algebras and c.e. presentations of unital (scaled) dimension groups, giving an effective version of Elliott's classification theorem.
